dau_consider_camp_main_02 = {
    if = {
        limit = { dau_eligible_camp_main_02 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = dau_any_eligible value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_gold value = dau_adjusted_cost_camp_main_02_gold }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_treasury value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_prestige value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_herd value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_influence value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_piety value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { dau_affordable_trigger = yes }
            set_variable = { name = dau_c_score value = { add = var:dau_c_gold add = var:dau_c_treasury } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = dau_candidate }
                        AND = {
                            domicile = { var:dau_priority = 1 }
                            var:dau_best_main = 0
                            always = yes
                        }
                        AND = {
                            OR = { domicile = { var:dau_priority = 0 } var:dau_best_main = 1 }
                            var:dau_c_score < var:dau_best_score
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_variable = { name = dau_candidate value = flag:camp_main_02 }
                set_variable = { name = dau_best_main value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = dau_best_score value = var:dau_c_score }
                set_variable = { name = dau_pay_gold value = var:dau_c_gold } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_treasury value = var:dau_c_treasury } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_prestige value = var:dau_c_prestige } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_herd value = var:dau_c_herd } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_influence value = var:dau_c_influence } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_piety value = var:dau_c_piety }
            }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { dau_eligible_treasury_reliquary_vault_02 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = dau_any_eligible value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_gold value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_treasury value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_prestige value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_herd value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_influence value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_piety value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_treasury = yes }
            change_variable = { name = dau_c_treasury add = dau_adjusted_cost_treasury_reliquary_vault_02_treasury_or_gold }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = dau_c_gold add = dau_adjusted_cost_treasury_reliquary_vault_02_treasury_or_gold } }
        if = {
            limit = { dau_affordable_trigger = yes }
            set_variable = { name = dau_c_score value = { add = var:dau_c_gold add = var:dau_c_treasury } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = dau_candidate }
                        AND = {
                            domicile = { var:dau_priority = 1 }
                            var:dau_best_main = 0
                            always = no
                        }
                        AND = {
                            OR = { domicile = { var:dau_priority = 0 } var:dau_best_main = 0 }
                            var:dau_c_score < var:dau_best_score
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_variable = { name = dau_candidate value = flag:treasury_reliquary_vault_02 }
                set_variable = { name = dau_best_main value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = dau_best_score value = var:dau_c_score }
                set_variable = { name = dau_pay_gold value = var:dau_c_gold } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_treasury value = var:dau_c_treasury } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_prestige value = var:dau_c_prestige } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_herd value = var:dau_c_herd } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_influence value = var:dau_c_influence } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_piety value = var:dau_c_piety }
            }
        }
    }
}

        limit = { dau_eligible_east_asian_estate_elephant_pasture_04 = yes }
        set_variable = { name = dau_any_eligible value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_gold value = dau_adjusted_cost_east_asian_estate_elephant_pasture_04_gold }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_treasury value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_prestige value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_herd value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_influence value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_piety value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { dau_affordable_trigger = yes }
            set_variable = { name = dau_c_score value = { add = var:dau_c_gold add = var:dau_c_treasury } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = dau_candidate }
                        AND = {
                            domicile = { var:dau_priority = 1 }
                            var:dau_best_main = 0
                            always = no
                        }
                        AND = {
                            OR = { domicile = { var:dau_priority = 0 } var:dau_best_main = 0 }
                            var:dau_c_score < var:dau_best_score
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_variable = { name = dau_candidate value = flag:east_asian_estate_elephant_pasture_04 }
                set_variable = { name = dau_best_main value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = dau_best_score value = var:dau_c_score }
                set_variable = { name = dau_pay_gold value = var:dau_c_gold } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_treasury value = var:dau_c_treasury } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_prestige value = var:dau_c_prestige } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_herd value = var:dau_c_herd } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_influence value = var:dau_c_influence } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_piety value = var:dau_c_piety }
            }
        }
    }
}

        set_variable = { name = dau_any_eligible value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_gold value = dau_adjusted_cost_storage_01_gold }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_treasury value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_prestige value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_herd value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_influence value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = dau_c_piety value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { dau_affordable_trigger = yes }
            set_variable = { name = dau_c_score value = { add = var:dau_c_gold add = var:dau_c_treasury } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = dau_candidate }
                        AND = {
                            domicile = { var:dau_priority = 1 }
                            var:dau_best_main = 0
                            always = no
                        }
                        AND = {
                            OR = { domicile = { var:dau_priority = 0 } var:dau_best_main = 0 }
                            var:dau_c_score < var:dau_best_score
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_variable = { name = dau_candidate value = flag:storage_01 }
                set_variable = { name = dau_best_main value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = dau_best_score value = var:dau_c_score }
                set_variable = { name = dau_pay_gold value = var:dau_c_gold } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_treasury value = var:dau_c_treasury } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_prestige value = var:dau_c_prestige } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_herd value = var:dau_c_herd } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_influence value = var:dau_c_influence } set_variable = { name = dau_pay_piety value = var:dau_c_piety }

        set_variable = { name = dau_c_herd value = 0 }

                        }
                        AND = {
                            OR = { domicile = { var:dau_priority = 0 } var:dau_best_main = 0 }
